title: Roles
text: A role is a set of permissions. Roles made here can be given to members of this unit and every unit below it.
empty_text: Start from a ready-made template for your sector, or build a role yourself.
no_access: Seeing roles needs the "Create and edit roles" or "Add members and give roles" permission.

list.read_only_hint: This role belongs to {name}. It can be changed only there.
list.delete_in_use: Remove it from its members first

create.title: Create a role
create.text: Start from a ready-made template, or start blank. You can change everything before saving.
create.left_out_one: {count} permission you cannot give is left out
create.left_out_other: {count} permissions you cannot give are left out

editor.name_required: Enter a name in at least one language.
editor.permissions_hint: {count} selected. Greyed permissions cannot be changed by you here.
editor.change_reason_text: Members who hold this role get the new permissions right away.
editor.unsaved_text: The changes to this role have not been saved.
editor.read_only_note: You can see this role but not change it here.
editor.conflict_footer: Two permissions here cannot be held together. See the warning above.

matrix.module_off_hint: Turn this module on first. Its permissions do nothing while it is off.
matrix.locked: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot give or remove it.
matrix.conflict: One person cannot hold both "{first}" and "{second}". Keep them in different roles given to different people.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.text: Nobody holds this role. It will be removed from the list; the audit log keeps a record.

members.owner_all: Owner: every permission except paired duties
members.dialog_text: Choose the roles {name} holds in {org}. Their permissions add up.
members.dialog_empty: No roles exist yet. Create roles first.
members.not_assignable: Contains permissions you do not hold
members.portal: Portal members see only their own records and cannot hold staff roles.
members.reason_placeholder: e.g. Moved to the accounts team

errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this role while you were editing. Reload it to see their changes, then apply yours again.
